purpose: Let users log in, see their tasks, add new tasks and delete tasks.
audience: Small teams using an existing task manager API; mostly desktop, sometimes phone.

api.auth: Bearer token returned by POST /api/auth/login, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>

pages.name: Login
pages.purpose: Sign in to reach the task list.
features: Validate both fields are filled before sending
Show an error on failed login
On success store the token for the session and go to the Tasks page

pages.name: Tasks
pages.purpose: See, add and delete your tasks.
content: Add task form with a title field and Add button
Task list showing title and done status
features: Loading, empty, error and success states for the list
Done is shown read-only because there is no update endpoint
Refresh the list after add and delete
Redirect to login when there is no token or the API returns 401

style.look_and_feel: Clean and professional, light theme, calm blue accent.

qualities.name: Intuitive
qualities.how: One main action per page, clear labels, helpful empty state.

qualities.name: Responsive
qualities.how: Mobile-first layout; the task list stays readable on a phone.

qualities.name: Accessible
qualities.how: Labels on every input, 4.5:1 contrast, visible focus outlines, keyboard usable.

notes: Front end only: HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no build step.
build_plan: 1. Shared stylesheet (styles.css) from the design tokens
2. API module (js/api.js) with mock data, switchable to the real API by one config value
